name: monzo-mcp
description: Ask Claude about your Monzo personal, joint or business account: balances, pots, transactions and spending. Read-only.
long_description:
Connects Claude to your Monzo account through Monzo's developer API, using an OAuth client you register yourself. Claude can show balances and pots, search transactions, and break down spending by category and merchant, for personal, joint and business accounts.

The extension is read-only: it cannot move money, change pots or edit transactions. It runs on your computer and talks directly to api.monzo.com. Your client secret is stored in your system's secure credential storage, and tokens and a transaction cache are kept in ~/.config/monzo-mcp on your computer.

client_id.title: Monzo Client ID
client_id.description: From the OAuth client you created at developers.monzo.com. It starts with oauth2client_.

client_secret.title: Monzo Client secret
client_secret.description: From the same OAuth client. Treat it like a password.

tools.name: monzo_login
tools.description: Sign in to Monzo in the browser. Changes nothing in your account.

tools.name: monzo_list_accounts
tools.description: List accounts and whether each is personal, joint or business.

tools.name: monzo_get_balance
tools.description: Current balance and spend today for one account.

tools.name: monzo_list_pots
tools.description: Pots and their balances for one account.

tools.name: monzo_sync
tools.description: Fetch new transactions into the local cache.

tools.name: monzo_search_transactions
tools.description: Search transactions by merchant, payee, description or notes.

tools.name: monzo_spending
tools.description: Spending by category and top merchants for a month.
